body:
Part of **New page: Strategy** (72986e081ef982d9). Every page piece is Gleam compiled to JavaScript; server pieces are Rust (`tasks.rs`, `board.rs`). Nothing compiles to BEAM.

- `PATCH` on several tasks at once (feature, milestone, and project if that is allowed).
- `DELETE /tasks/{id}` with a confirmation.
- Archiving: set `archivedTime`, and decide whether the board hides archived tasks. D-87 point 3 left this open. (See also **Remove completed tasks from board**, 399a97660fe6863a.)
- Server-side search over notes and changes.

All Rust plus the Tasks tab.

**Scope:** `solace-cli/strategy` is not in the root `solace.toml` yet. A human adds it, then it is added to this task's scope.
title: Strategy: mass edits and archiving
